method: Dice: cyclic order around common face T
steps: T is on top in both views
Around T: S then M (fig 1), P then R (fig 2) in the same order
Cycle S, M, opp(S), opp(M) must contain P,R consecutively -> P=opp(S), R=opp(M)
check_code:
def cycle_opposite(v1,v2,letters):
    # v1,v2: (a,b) pairs seen in the same cyclic order around the common face at the same position
    # cycle around common face = [a, b, a', b']; find assignment of opposites consistent with v2
    a,b=v1; c,d=v2
    others=[x for x in letters]
    sols=[]
    import itertools
    rest=[x for x in others if x not in (a,b)]
    for oa,ob in itertools.permutations(rest,2):
        cyc=[a,b,oa,ob]
        for i in range(4):
            if cyc[i]==c and cyc[(i+1)%4]==d: sols.append({a:oa,oa:a,b:ob,ob:b})
    return sols

sols=cycle_opposite(("S","M"),("P","R"),["S","M","P","R"])
assert len(sols)==1
ans=sols[0]["M"]
opts={"A":"C","B":"R","C":"S","D":"P"}
assert ans==opts["B"]
for k in "ACD": assert ans!=opts[k]
